court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Ghaziabad (Divorce Petition No.1528 of 2020)
case_name: Shilpa Sharma vs Aman Kumar Sharma
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2019. The husband and his family demanded dowry and harassed the wife, leading her to leave their home and file a maintenance petition under Section 125 Cr.P.C. The husband then filed for divorce under Section-13(1) (ia) (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider a case on its merit if the respondent has no objection.
legal_principles.held: In view of above, specific and categorical view expressed by the counsel for the respondent, this case is being considered on its merit on the claim raised and the reply given in open Court by the learned counsel for the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to attend outstation proceedings may be considered as a hardship.
legal_principles.held: She being housewife left with no source of livelihood is unable to meet expenses and to go to District - Ghaziabad. In case, the proceeding at District - Ghaziabad is allowed to go on, that would cause great hardship to the applicant.

outcome.final_order: The case was transferred from Principal Judge, Family Court, Ghaziabad to Principal Judge, Family Court, Hapur.
